page.layout: One page of an alphabetical index in two columns, each printed line running across both columns (left entry, then right entry, with page numbers at the right). Running head "INDEX" at top. Page number "X." at top right. Catchword "Bre" at bottom right.

page.notes: Top mark "INDEX" with a following colon-like mark, read as running head. Page number "X." read as roman X. "ferdiſtum" first word is doubtful (could be another word beginning with f or p). "Romoe" at line 12 right side is doubtful (possibly Romæ). "Bosius Sforcia" in line 21 is doubtful: the right-hand word may read "Sforzia". "Bononiam" and "Tridentinum" lines have a broken right column; the right-hand "um" at line 20 is a continuation of "Tridentinum concilii-um". Some page numbers are faint and may be misread (e.g. 150, 309, 506).
